scope: ARX X5, L0 pill task, real human-video-conditioned ACT engineering loop

source.post_run_change: single-task configuration/recorded-task pairing validation only; no network, optimizer or rollout changes

dataset.name: arx_x5-pill-v1
dataset.aggregate_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(dataset_input_files,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False), sorted by relative path; records contain path,size_bytes,sha256; meta/data/videos only, excluding .cache

training.model: official visual video-conditioned ACT / ResNet18 / frozen DINOv2 ViT-L14
training.normalization: bounds_q99; minimum range=0.01 native units; selected training rows only
training.loss: padding-masked L1 + 10 * KL, KL summed over posterior coordinates then batch averaged
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update 6000 before evaluation; checkpoint 3000 retained
training.hardware: one NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada Generation, 48 GiB

rollout.existing_native_action_limit_clamp: retained; clipped-step counts reported per seed; no new rejection criterion

conditioning_diagnostic.purpose: condition wiring diagnostic; single-task differences do not establish semantic video understanding

tests.scope: CPU interfaces plus real decoded clips; real pretrained model, training and simulator rollouts are separate evidence

limits: One body and one task at L0; not full TIG L0-L3 or official main-table evaluation.
ARX expert action supervision is used; this is not zero-shot transfer to a new embodiment.
Five final evaluation seeds are a small engineering sample; they were used previously by the native non-video ACT workflow.
Same-task video replacement causes a very small action difference; this does not establish semantic video use or cross-task generalization.
6000 updates is a fixed interface-validation budget, not a demonstrated convergence point.

seed_history.scope: retained local recording metadata, structured seed fields, command receipts and source documentation; excludes other hosts and deleted history

direct_new_seed_regression.measurement: direct read-only normalized, requested and executed arrays from live native rollout
direct_new_seed_regression.physical_mapping_note: For this ARX controller, each finger position target is 0.022*(command+1) metres. Excess*22 is a hypothetical per-finger target correction in mm, not measured physical travel or penetration.

reconstruction_preprocessing_check.conclusion: Live renderer RGB was scaled on CUDA. Scaling saved uint8 RGB on CUDA reproduces all five archived action arrays bitwise; CPU scaling differs by at most one ULP at input. Both have matching contiguous layout. Initial approximate reconstruction retained as a numerical control.

controller_interpretation.arm_actions: absolute radian targets; twelve arm coordinates had no bound exceedances in old or new measurements
controller_interpretation.arm_bounds: simulation prepared-URDF limits: joint1..5 [-10,10] rad; joint6 [-3.14,3.14] rad per arm, not manufacturer hardware limits
controller_interpretation.normalization: saved bounds_q99 with minimum width 0.01; gripper q01/q99 are [-1,1], so its inverse scaling is the identity
controller_interpretation.model_output: linear ACT action head has no final tanh; small endpoint overshoots are retained until the existing controller-space clamp
controller_interpretation.interpretation: Observed clipping is small gripper endpoint overshoot; independent affine inverse checks found no action-range or denormalization mismatch.

tests.read_only_boundary: diagnostics on/off preserve every executed action, reward, termination and official success in the fixture

action_limit_followup.execution_changes: No changes to existing clamp, thresholds, normalization, model weights, termination or success; new optional diagnostics default off.
